selection_rationale: Directly relevant to the system's own domain; well-defined artifact structure; feasible with prompt/template changes.
required_journeys: create or draft a new document
assign identifier, version, or release tag
view document detail or release notes
expected_ui_components: document list or release history table
expected_backend_behavior: document list returns array with id, title, version or date fields
create document assigns an identifier and persists
release history endpoint returns ordered list of past releases
acceptance_criteria: Document list renders with domain-specific labels (title, version, date — not 'item')
Create document form assigns an identifier and appears in the list after submission
Release history or changelog view renders at least one historical entry
QA report includes evidence for at least 3 of the 4 required journeys
example_pass: Document list shows 2+ entries with title/version; create form opens; new doc appears in list with assigned ID.
example_fail: Page renders 'Item List' with 'Sample Item 1'; create button appends a hardcoded row client-side only.
